title: Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve
subject: Geography
caption: Map of the Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve showing islands, estuaries, beaches, coral reefs, salt marshes, and mangroves along the Tamil Nadu coast.
altText: A textbook-quality map on a white background depicting the Gulf of Mannar Biosphere Reserve. The map displays the coastline of Tamil Nadu with labeled islands, estuaries, and beaches. Coral reef areas are shaded in bright orange, mangrove zones in green, and salt marshes in light brown. A north arrow, scale bar, and legend explain the symbols. Each feature is clearly labelled with arrows pointing to the corresponding area, providing an accurate visual representation of the region's marine and coastal ecosystems.
